text:
lee (PM): Quick thread: proposing a regional rollout pattern that ties an A/B experiment to fallback tiers. Goal: be able to run an A/B for a new model while ensuring auto-degrade across regions if errors spike.

rachel (eng): High-level ok. Need to define how we map experiment buckets to fallback tiers (e.g., A->primary, B->primary+fallback).

lee (PM): My sketch: three-tier fallback per region: green (new model), amber (stable model + cache), red (legacy). A/B experiment runs in green only. If green breach, traffic moves to amber automatically.

tom (sre): Automatic movement needs strict thresholds and a cool-down window. Suggest: breach if 5xx > 0.8% for 3m OR latency p95 > baseline*1.35 for 2m. Cool-down 10m after rollback before re-trying.

mina (data): We'll track experiment metrics separately (CTR of acceptance, generation-quality score, hallucination proxy). Need to correlate by region + tier + experiment_id.

rachel (eng): Implementation notes: routing config per-region with ordered fallbacks. Edge keeps routing version and tier flag. Control-plane exposes endpoints to step region from green->amber->red. We'll support soft-shift (pct-based) and hard-shift (full region).

lee (PM): Example config idea:
```
region: eu-west-1
experiment_id: exp-2024-08-mlv2
buckets:
  - name: green
    pct: 10
    model: mlv2-canary
    fallback: amber
  - name: amber
    pct: 90
    model: mlv2-stable
    fallback: red
  - name: red
    pct: 0
    model: mlv1-legacy
auto_rules:
  breach_conditions:
    5xx_rate: {threshold: 0.8, window_mins: 3}
    p95_latency_increase_pct: {threshold: 35, window_mins: 2}
  actions:
    - on_breach: move_region_to: amber
    - on_persistent_breach: move_region_to: red
cooldown_minutes: 10
approval_gate: prod-only, requires oncall signoff for full-region hard-shift
```

mina (data): For A/B analysis, we'll run both automatic checks (safety) and a daily statistical summary (quality delta, p-value) so we can decide roll-forward.

tom (sre): Add: audit log entry for every auto-rule action and human-initiated shift. Also rate-limit auto-shifts to 1 per hour per region to avoid flapping.

rachel (eng): Edge invalidation: we should support graceful draining of connections for nodes in a region when we change tier. Also, if soft-shift pct change, propagate via async feature-flag stream.

lee (PM): Launch criteria proposal:
- Canary at 5-10% green for 48h with no safety breaches
- Daily quality delta within expected margin and no customer complaints
- SRE runbook validated in staging with a simulated breach
- Approval gate tested (oncall can force amber/red and verify logs)

mina (data): I'll prepare baseline metrics for each region and create a one-click dashboard that shows experiment_id, tier distribution, p95, 5xx, and quality score delta.

tom (sre): I'll add the runbook steps: simulate breach -> verify auto-move -> verify cool-down -> manual rollback steps. Also define PD escalation if amber->red happens in >2 regions in 30m.

rachel (eng): One open question: do we allow a tenant-level override inside a region (e.g., sales-tenant forced green even if amber for region)? That complicates routing precedence.

lee (PM): Short answer: yes, but only with an approval flag and strict audit. Tenant-level overrides override region tier but not global kill-switch. Documenting precedence: tenant_override -> region_tier -> global_fallback.

devops-bot: Scheduled: experiment exp-2024-08-mlv2.canary queued for eu-west-1 at 2024-09-16T09:00Z

mina (data): I'll attach the prompt-set and quality rubric in the experiment ticket.

lee (PM): Owners: Rachel -> routing schema + edge draining, Mina -> baselines + dashboard, Tom -> runbook + PD rules. I'll own experiment gating and customer comms. Reconvene Thu 11 for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
